title: Talk it through 3.4
role: Host introducing local culture to a visitor and comparing it with the visitor's own
can_do: I can describe local customs and traditions.
I can say how customs differ and talk about trends.

nodes.partner_line: What is a typical custom in your town?
nodes.translation: ¿Cuál es una costumbre típica en su pueblo?

options.text: We celebrate the harvest with a big festival.
People greet everyone in the street.

nodes.partner_line: How is it different from my country?
nodes.translation: ¿En qué se diferencia de mi país?
nodes.model_reply: It is similar, but our festival is longer.

nodes.partner_line: Is the festival the same every year?

options.text: Mostly, but every year there are new dances.
Yes, it has been the same for a hundred years.
No, it grows bigger every year.

nodes.partner_line: Which trends are becoming popular among young people?
nodes.translation: ¿Qué tendencias se están volviendo populares entre los jóvenes?

options.text: More young people are wearing traditional clothes.
Local food is getting more and more popular.

nodes.partner_line: Do people still wear traditional clothes?

options.text: Not every day, but many people have a special outfit.
Older people wear it more often than young people.

nodes.partner_line: That's interesting. I'd like to learn more.
nodes.translation: Qué interesante. Me gustaría aprender más.

options.text: I can introduce you to a local family.
You could join a workshop tomorrow.
I will show you a good book about it.
